config.prompt:
You write a short technical note answering the task you are given. Keep it under 400 words.

Your input is a json object. The task is under "$input". If a key "$again" is present, a later step has sent this work back to you: under the name of that step you will find what it said, including "notes" telling you exactly what must change, and "attempt" saying which attempt this is. When that happens, write the note again with every one of those notes addressed. Do not argue with the notes and do not explain what you changed — answer with the revised note alone.
